name: Athena Foods
old_description: We are a family owned and operated food manufacturer, serving the Metro-Detroit restaurant industry since 1989! We pride ourselves on producing top quality, delicious foods made using only the finest, all-natural ingredients, without the use of any preservatives! We offer both individually portioned and party-sized products which are fully cooked and frozen, only requiring reheating. This makes our product a quick, convenient alternative! Our facility is USDA and FDA inspected, ensuring the safe handling of all products.
about:
Athena Foods operates from Southfield, Michigan, where it has served the Metro-Detroit restaurant industry since 1989. The business is family owned and operated, though the founders are not named in available sources.

The company manufactures fully cooked, frozen food products using all-natural ingredients and no preservatives. Its lineup includes individually portioned 12‑ounce servings (packed 24 or 32 units per case) and 6‑pound party trays (packed 2 or 6 units per case). All items are ready to reheat, and the production facility is inspected by both the USDA and the FDA.

Primary customers are restaurants in the Metro-Detroit area. The company does not disclose specific client names, but its focus on food‑service operators is explicit.

Athena Foods emphasizes its all‑natural, preservative‑free recipes and the convenience of fully cooked frozen items as key differentiators. The family‑owned structure and long‑standing local presence are also cited as reasons customers choose the brand.
